experiment_name: Tree-Local Similarity Router with Gold-Overlap Training
training_unit: one 160-token-rooted tree overlapping deduplicated gold evidence

local_target.source: GPT-2 token length of merged gold-evidence intervals clipped to this root
local_target.mapping: nearest candidate, smaller exact-midpoint tie, clamp extremes

input_features.source: question-to-chunk cosine similarities within this tree only

classifier.class_weighting: sqrt(max_class_count / class_count), recalculated on local-tree labels
classifier.model_selection: none; fixed settings inherited from Phase 3B

inference.tree_score: average of mean similarities at levels 10,20,40,80,160
inference.primary_chunk_selection: single most similar chunk at predicted level per tree
inference.exploratory_chunk_selection: all chunks at predicted level per tree; reported separately with variable chunk count

evaluation.primary: joined GPT-2 token-level Precision/Recall/F1 over five selected chunks
evaluation.exploratory_variant: retain all descendants at each predicted level
evaluation.validation_status: development result because validation was reused in prior phases

prohibited: Qdrant writes, collection creation, deletion, rebuilding, or re-indexing
